The objective of this procurement procedure is to conclude a Contract for the development, deployment, qualification and support to accreditation of the Multi-Component Security Monitoring System (“MC SECMON”), based on a pre-existing SECMON development baseline, as relevant.
The MC SECMON will contribute to the establishment of the EU Space Security Operations Centre (SOC) enabling the provision of harmonised and state-of-the-art security monitoring capabilities across all components of the Union Space Programme. The Contract may also include optional activities, in particular the maintenance and support to operations of the MC SECMON. - Deployment and qualification of the MC SECMON; 
- Support to accreditation activities;

normalized.title: Multi-Component Security Monitoring System for the EU Space Security Operations Centre (SOC)
normalized.description:
Disclaimer: the description of the nature and scope of the services and supplies of the Multi-Component Security Monitoring System for the EU Space SOC procurement is only indicative, aimed at outlining the concept in broad terms and it may need substantial adjustments. Therefore, it shall not be considered final nor binding. 
The objective of this procurement procedure is to conclude a Contract for the development, deployment, qualification and support to accreditation of the Multi-Component Security Monitoring System (“MC SECMON”), based on a pre-existing SECMON development baseline, as relevant.
The MC SECMON will contribute to the establishment of the EU Space Security Operations Centre (SOC) enabling the provision of harmonised and state-of-the-art security monitoring capabilities across all components of the Union Space Programme. The Contract may also include optional activities, in particular the maintenance and support to operations of the MC SECMON. The activities to be performed under the Contract include, at high level, the following: 
- Development and integration of the MC SECMON; 
- Deployment and qualification of the MC SECMON; 
- Support to accreditation activities;
- Where the relevant options are exercised, maintenance and support to operations of the MC SECMON; 
- Where the relevant options are exercised, development and deployment of additional MC SECMON enclaves and other system evolutions.

a) obiectul de activitate al ofertantului; obiectul contractului trebuie să aibă corespondent în CAEN din certificatul constatator emis de ONRC;

c) persoanele care reprezintă ofertantul în relația cu terții.Informațiile cuprinse în acest document, trebuie să fie reale/actuale la data prezentării.

- autoritatea contractantă acceptă prezentarea certificatului constatator emis de către ONRC în forma electronică, prin intermediul serviciului online InfoCert, având incorporată, atașata sau logic asociată semnatura electronică extinsă.
-	operatorii economici străini: vor prezenta documente edificatoare, traduse în limba română de către un traducător autorizat, reale/actuale la data prezentării, care să dovedească o formă de înregistrare ca persoana fizică/juridică sau de înregistrare/atestare ori apartenență din punct de vedere profesional și în care să se menționeze persoanele care reprezintă operatorul economic în relațiile cu terții, în conformitate cu prevederile legale din țara în care ofertantul este rezident.

Ofertantul trebuie să facă dovada că deține experiență în derularea unor contracte de livrări de produse similare, în cursul unei perioade care acoperă cel mult ultimii 3 ani până la data limită de depunere a ofertei, în valoare de minim 4.958.141 lei fără TVA. 
În perioada de referință, ofertantul trebuie să dețină experiență relevantă în furnizarea de produse similare cu obiectul contractului.
Ofertantii trebuie să facă dovada că, în ultimii 3 ani raportați la data-limită de depunere a ofertelor, a dus la bun sfârșit livrări similare, cu o valoare cumulată de minimum 4.958.141 lei fără TVA (aceasta valoare cuprinde numai partea prestată de ofertanți în cazul în care a participat într-o asociere sau ca subcontractant). Ultimii 3 ani se calculează retroactiv de la data-limită a depunerii ofertelor stabilită de autoritatea contractantă prin anunțul de participare, cu mențiunea că modul de calcul al perioadei nu va fi afectat de eventuale decalări ale termenului-limită prevăzut în anunțul de participare publicat. Astfel, dacă se decalează termenul de depunere a ofertelor, se va extinde corespunzător (cu zilele de decalare) și perioada aferentă experienței similare.
Prin „livrări similare” se înțelege furnizarea unei soluții integrate de tip GIS Enterprise sau soluții echivalente ca nivel de complexitate și funcționalitate, care a inclus, după caz:
a) echipamente hardware (servere rack-abile, storage hibrid, appliance backup & recovery, switch-uri Ethernet, firewall-uri),
b) software specializat pentru backup & recovery și GIS (licențe server GIS Enterprise, server pentru procesarea și publicarea datelor raster, aplicații desktop GIS standard și avansat, extensii pentru analize spațiale, geostatistice, 3D și interoperabilitate),

Concentrating satellite connectivity exclusively on coverage gap areas (including low service areas) rather than aiming for satellite connectivity over a broad coverage has the potential to maximize the efficiency of the satellite system. It could offer an increased throughput which translates in reduced deployment costs per bit and higher quality of service for end users. Moreover, this approach could enable flexible resources allocation based on the population density as well as step up and step down of terrestrial connectivity services.This activity will design,implement and evaluate satellite system architectural models addressing non-uniform spatiotemporal traffic patterns in particular of handheld services. First, the activity will develop a high-resolution spatiotemporal traffic model, which shall consider available datasets and trend analyses of service requirements of Mobile Network Operators (MNOs) and their representative organisations, along with actual and target service coverage obligation set by National Regulation Administrations (NRAs) for terrestrial network gaps. The outputs of this model will be used to define coverage gaps from existing and planned terrestrial networks and space networks. The activity will then study and implement in a software prototype Distributed Satellite System (DSS) concepts for Frequency Range 1 (FR1) considering different orbits, multi-connectivity techniques (e.g. beam overlapping, coordinated multi-point etc) and infrastructure configurations (e.g. fractionated, swarm and federated concepts). normalized.title: TALLINN HELSINKI OPTICAL RELAY (THOR) TESTBED (ARTES 4.0 SL SPL 6C.092) - REQUESTED
normalized.description: The objective of the activity is to define and develop a free space optical communication testbed suitable for testing a cross-atmospheric optical connectivity in the horizontal link between Tallinn and Helsinki. Targeted Improvements: To create a terrestrial testbed capability allowing for demonstration and long-term communication testing. The testbed will provide information on the long-distance atmospheric channel and the stability of the optical links in fixed and mobile configuration. The testbed facility will support new technology developments for optical and quantum satellite communication. Description: Most of satellite constellations developed these days include intersatellite links. However, the adaptation of cross-atmospheric links remains to be progressing slowly. One of the challenges is the limited availability of outdoor, free-space testbeds. The proposed testbed facility will enable testing over the long-distance, cross-atmospheric channel created between two stations located in Tallinn and Helsinki. The testbed will allow for fixed-points free-space optical connection, demonstrating and validating a continuous datalink between interoperable terminals and transceivers aligned with satellite optical communication standards. The testbed should allow to collect and analyse information on the atmospheric channel over multiple seasons. It should monitor weather conditions and investigate beam dissipation dynamics and various mitigation strategies. The spatially dynamic optical links will also be demonstrated to test and validate a free-space optical datalink between moving terminals. The testbed should foresee and facilitate testing of quantum-encrypted free-space optical communication capabilities. The preparation to demonstrate data-relay with a satellite link is planned to be included in the activity.
